## Brand Strategy
- **Brand ambition (3-5 year):** Continue as VR category leader and become synonymous with VR overall. Three goals: make VR more approachable, establish VR in daily life, reimagine VR as a community/connection space.
- **Brand belief:** "We believe that what we do in virtual reality can connect us more deeply to our own reality."
- **Brand role:** The Catalyst -- Oculus is the spark for new ways to play, create, and connect.
- **Brand positioning:** "Oculus is where we go for experiences that expand our perspectives."
- Brand architecture and visual motif sections included.

## Logo
- Two primary lockups: "The Stadium" (icon) and "Wordmark Lockup."
- **Minimum sizes:** Stadium -- Print 10mm / Digital 50px; Wordmark Lockup -- Print 20mm / Digital 100px.
- **Clearspace:** Defined by the width of the Stadium icon (X); exclusion zone is X on all sides.
- Extensive logo section (pages 10-38) covering: endorsement lockups, placement rules, large applications, stadium sizes, content partnerships, stacked lockups, branded offer lockups, common pitfalls, optical adjustments.
- TOC suggests very granular logo guidance across 28+ pages.
